slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Use AI to clarify before you code
slides.subtitle: A chat assistant can turn a vague idea into a project spec.

slides.title: Start outside the coding agent
slides.body: Use a chat assistant for product scoping. The goal is not implementation. The goal is to make decisions explicit.

slides.title: Ask one question at a time
slides.body: This keeps the session interactive and avoids a wall of text. You answer one decision, then move to the next.

slides.title: Turn the idea into scope
slides.body: Define users, workflow, anonymity, feedback timing, voting, action items, roles, screens, and MVP exclusions.

slides.title: Then code
slides.body: The coding agent becomes much more useful when it receives a direction instead of a vague wish.

slides.supportingText: Spec-driven development with AI coding agents.
